historySize.Name: Feedback: actions kept per player
historySize.Hint: How many recent actions (clicks, windows, rolls, token selection) each client keeps to attach to its next bug report. 20 to 1000; applies at once.

captureConsole.Name: Feedback: attach console errors
captureConsole.Hint: Also record console errors and warnings into each report's error list. Needs a reload.

Dialog.Title: Report a bug or idea
Dialog.Intro: Tell us what happened. Your last few minutes of actions and the game state are attached so it can be reproduced.
Dialog.Legend: What kind of report is it?
Dialog.Placeholder: What were you trying to do, what happened, and what did you expect?

Attach.Title: What gets attached
Attach.Chat: {n} of your own chat messages (roll names and totals only)
Attach.Never: Never attached: other players' chat, whisper text, setting values, or anything typed into a form.

bug.Label: Bug
bug.Help: It is just broken. If you don't know which to pick, Bug is a good default.

defect.Label: Defect
defect.Help: It works, just not the way you expect, so it comes across as a bug. If you don't know, pick Bug.

feature.Label: Feature
feature.Help: 100% new: it does not exist yet, like a new tab or a new subsystem.

Notify.Queued: No GM is online; your report {id} will be sent when one connects.
Notify.Dropped: Your unsent queue was full: the {n} oldest unsent report(s) were dropped.
